name: Wizard Wants a Loan
source:
The great and powerful bisexual "wizard" Vincent recently found himself in need of some money, and decided to try for a loan. Can he receive it, or will he not? 

[From [url=https://pinkleafsheep.itch.io/wizard-wants-a-loan]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
伟大而法力高强的双性恋“大魔法师”文森特最近手头拮据，决定去尝试申请一笔贷款。他究竟能否顺利贷到款呢？

[摘自[url=https://pinkleafsheep.itch.io/wizard-wants-a-loan]itch.io[/url]]
